items.title: Register Antigravity as a first-class host runtime
items.context: Current host runtime validation and probe code only accepts fake, claude-code, gemini, and codex. Add antigravity with command agy and keep any Gemini handling explicitly legacy/deprecated.

happy.desc: host_runtime_probe accepts antigravity and agy, normalizes both to host antigravity, and reports cliCommand agy.

edge.desc: When agy is missing from PATH, the probe reports unavailable or missing-cli with an actionable nextAction and does not fall back to another current host.

adversarial.desc: Gemini is treated only as deprecated legacy compatibility, not as a current runtime advertised or preferred by Antigravity registration paths.

items.title: Update dispatch policy and runtime surfaces for the current three-host set
items.context: Host runtime list/probe/status and policy allow-lists must recognize Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI. Error messages and docs should stop presenting Gemini as a current host.

happy.desc: host list, docs, and policy surfaces show the current three real hosts as codex, claude-code, and antigravity, with agy as the Antigravity CLI command.

edge.desc: Dispatch policy creation and checks accept antigravity as an allowed host and persist or report the normalized current host value.

adversarial.desc: User-facing errors, help, and policy messages do not advertise Gemini as a current host; any Gemini mention is explicitly legacy or deprecated.

items.title: Verify agy host detection and legacy Gemini behavior
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage or command verification proving host_runtime_probe accepts antigravity/agy and reports the agy command, while Gemini remains legacy rather than the advertised current host.

happy.desc: Focused smoke coverage proves node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity --format=json and --host=agy --format=json both resolve to host antigravity with cliCommand agy and an agy invocation template while preserving authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.
Logic coverage proves probeHostRuntime and listHostRuntimes expose Antigravity as a current runtime and keep Codex and Claude Code present as the other current real hosts.

edge.desc: The agy detection test covers both installed and missing binary conditions through a deterministic stub or equivalent command-path control, proving the missing-binary path reports unavailable or missing-cli without login prompts, help hangs, or subprocess execution.

Legacy Gemini behavior is explicit and tested: --host=gemini is either rejected or reported as legacy/deprecated compatibility, but it is not emitted by the default current runtime list, fallback selection, or policy examples.

adversarial.desc: A policy or dispatch request that names gemini cannot schedule Gemini as a current unattended host and cannot become the fallback when Antigravity is unavailable; the error or degradation must point users to codex, claude-code, antigravity, or fake as appropriate.

Regression search or assertions cover stale Gemini-first strings across runtime enum, host order, error messages, CLI help, README, docs/guide.md, and related decision docs, with any remaining Gemini mentions labeled legacy rather than current.
